app_store_connect_setup_checklist: 1. Go to App Store Connect → Your App → Subscriptions
2. Create subscription group 'OpenIntelligence Plans' with ID 'com.openintelligence.subscriptions'
7. Keep 'Document Pack' (doc_pack_addon) only for legacy compatibility if it already exists
8. Do not surface Document Pack purchase UI in the app for new users
9. Add localizations for each product matching this file
10. Set review notes for each product
11. Submit all products for review (can be done with app submission)
12. Verify product IDs match BillingProduct.swift exactly
